scene: Inside the rumbling cab, the tow truck driver hums through neon drizzle.
beats: Static crackles into smooth synth jazz as the tow truck halts under buzzing discharge tubes. The passenger door glides open onto Neon Sign Hospital.
A chilled coil of argon tubing glows inside with a gentle hum. The driver honks twice, braking beside glowing torches as the door clicks open.
The driver taps the flamingo, sparking a flash of hot pink brilliance. You roll through the wide hangar doors, which swing open with a hiss.
picture: Side view inside the wide truck cab. On the left, the silver CB radio sits on the dash beside the robotic driver. In the centre, the player sits on a bench seat beside a glowing blue foam cooler. Up high, an unlit miniature neon flamingo hangs from the mirror.
shown: a bulky silver CB radio with dangling microphone on the left dashboard
a blue foam cooler glowing with faint purple light sitting in centre
a miniature neon flamingo hanging unlit from the rear-view mirror up high

after.label: Step off at Neon Sign Hospital
Stay on
after.beat: You wave the hospital goodbye as the tow truck rattles on. At the depot, you board a clanking bridge crawler that carries you up to Gear Bridge's turning cogs.

variants.scene: Rain patters on the glass while your metallic driver cheerfully hums along.
beats: Warm synth melodies chime across the cab as the truck rolls to a stop under buzzing violet lamps. The door swings wide at Neon Sign Hospital.
Frosty violet rays beam from the lid, cooling your face until the truck honks twice and brakes. The side door unlocks with a welcoming click.
With a gentle tap, the flamingo flares into electric pink light. The truck glides smoothly through open hangar doors that hiss to welcome you.
variants.ride_on: Waving goodbye to the hospital, you rumble onward to the depot. A clattering bridge crawler lifts you straight up into the giant ticking cogs of Gear Bridge.

variants.scene: The cozy cab rattles steadily as rain blurs the glowing city streets.
beats: Lively synth notes whistle over the speaker as the truck coasts under humming purple lights. The side door slides open to reveal Neon Sign Hospital.
Inside rests icy argon glass glowing purple and buzzing softly. The driver taps the horn twice, pulling to the curb as your door clicks ajar.
The tiny bird lights up with brilliant pink sunshine at a tap. The truck drives smoothly inside, and the tall hangar doors hiss shut behind.
variants.ride_on: Leaving the hospital behind, you ride along to the terminal. You hop aboard a clanking crawler that carries you up among the spinning wheels of Gear Bridge.
